answer.report_md:
### 画出来要什么
双面板分组柱图，每面板含季度与年份两层时间轴、重复的百分比纵轴、负值和加粗零线；共享四系列图例置于下方，并保留竖排轴题、面板标题、注释和来源行。

### 定位一个值难在哪
“1.3”需以“China / 2023 / Q4 / Solar PV integrated mfg”四键定位；数值未印出，而纵轴每格10个百分点，远大于其5%容差0.065。

### 不确定的
零高度柱可能与缺值无法区分；若干精确值只能按柱端位置和给定数值反推。图中未见图号，标题第二行按副标题处理。

heading.title: Weighted average net margins of renewable energy companies and large utilities
heading.subtitle: (Q1 2023-Q2 2025)

axes.serves: all bars in Outside of China
all quarterly groups in Outside of China

worked_example.why_hard: Ten-point tick spacing cannot support the 0.065 tolerance around 1.3.

components.evidence: Multiple coloured bars stand side by side within each quarterly slot.
A dark horizontal zero line crosses both panels at 0%.
Bars extend below the 0% line toward ticks down to -30%.
One four-item legend spans beneath both “China” and “Outside of China” panels.
The same quarterly grouped-bar construction repeats in two panels.
“Note: mfg = equipment manufacturing companies.” and “Source: IEA analysis based on Bloomberg LP…” appear below.
The four legend entries form one row beneath the two plots.
“China” and “Outside of China” are centred above their respective panels.
“Weighted average net margin” runs vertically beside the left panel.
Quarter labels Q1–Q4 sit above grouped year labels 2023–2025.
“Q1”, “Q2”, “Q3” and “Q4” are used as time ticks.
Only horizontal grey grid lines cross each plot area.

new_components.name: unit_in_tick_labels
new_components.evidence: Every value tick includes “%”, from -30% through 30%; the axis title omits it.

new_components.name: panel_specific_series_presence
new_components.evidence: Purple Utilities bars appear only in Outside of China although the shared legend lists Utilities.

spot_checks.mark: the China 2024 Q4 Wind integrated mfg zero-height bar
the China 2025 Q2 Solar PV integrated mfg bar
the China 2023 Q3 Wind integrated mfg bar
the China 2023 Q4 Solar PV integrated mfg bar
the Outside of China 2023 Q1 Polysilicon bar
the Outside of China 2024 Q3 Wind integrated mfg bar

answer.hardest_step_why: 1.3的容差仅0.065，而纵轴每格10个百分点，无法可靠读准，故最卡第2步。争论点主要不在标题层级，而在数值是否打印、零线及负值结构、双层时间轴，以及单位究竟由标题、轴题还是刻度携带。图中最难的例子是 China–2023–Q4–Solar PV integrated mfg 的 1.3：它需要面板、年份、季度、系列四个键，而且数值并未标注，只能在 0% 与 10% 网格间估读。另一个重要发现是共享图例中的 Utilities 只在 “Outside of China” 面板出现，使图例系列数与各面板实际柱数不一致。零高度柱与缺失值也难从图面区分。图号确实未显示；标题第一行和括号时间范围适合拆为 title/subtitle。技术实现上应保留双面板相同量程但各自重复纵轴，而不是误报 shared_axis。来源与注释位于图下，许可证文字位于右侧，不应混入图例或来源字段。

examples.quote: “China” and “Outside of China” title the two repeated grouped-bar panels.
examples.why: 同一季度与系列会在两面板重复，面板名必须进入值键。

examples.quote: Bars extend below the bold 0% line; ticks run from -30% to 30%.
examples.why: 需要控制负值柱、零线粗细、百分比刻度格式和单位位置。

examples.quote: “Weighted average net margins of renewable energy companies and large utilities” followed by “(Q1 2023-Q2 2025)”.
examples.why: 必须分别生成标题、副标题、单位及其位于绘图区上方的位置。

examples.quote: The 1.3 bar has no value label and lies between 0% and 10% grid lines.
examples.why: 小数值的5%容差远小于网格间距，可读精度应按标记单独判断。

examples.quote: Utilities appears in the shared legend but has bars only under “Outside of China”.
examples.why: 需支持共享图例系列在不同面板选择性缺席，而非自动补零柱。
